ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible surface, contrasted by a low-intensity (black) boundary and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes; low-intensity black continuous band along the trailing edge; discrete dark circular focal points distributed bilaterally across the white interior.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65-75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge boundary featuring high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (serrations) isolated against the lighter water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edges of both the left and right lobes from the notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: At least 10 distinct, dark circular pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the ventral surface, showing high contrast against the white base pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Brownish-orange high-contrast pixel clusters indicating barnacle colonization at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
